integrity: Self-contained derivation and a seeded standard-library diagnostic; asymptotic proof is analytic, finite simulations illustrative only.
scientific_limitations: Only exact-arithmetic 3-by-3 interior Hermitian eigenexample, unoversampled complex Gaussian 3-by-2 Petrov-Galerkin test, and oracle-best of the two Ritz vectors; no general-dimensional, real Gaussian, oversampled, nonlinear, or refined-Ritz theorem. The deterministic matrix and subspace originate in Shao (2026). Independent mathematical validation and global historical priority are not established.
title: The logarithmic mean-square price of Gaussian randomized Rayleigh–Ritz for an interior eigenvector
